description: Given a product (by Lowvyn ID, retailer URL, or a lowvyn.com product URL from another tool's result) and an optional claimed price, return whether the deal is genuine. Compares against Lowvyn's price history and returns a verdict ('real_deal', 'modest_deal', 'average', 'bad_time', 'insufficient_data') plus an explanation. Use this when a user asks 'is this actually a good price?' and other retailers don't matter; check_deal answers that and the cheaper-elsewhere question in one call. Accepts the id or canonicalUrl from a search_products / intent_search result directly. watchUrl is a lowvyn.com link where the user can get an email when the price drops. checkUrl and extensionUrl are returned when the product is not tracked yet.

claimedPrice.description: The price the deal claims, in CAD; omit to verify the live tracked price

idOrUrl.description: Lowvyn product ID, a retailer URL (amazon.ca, walmart.ca, bestbuy.ca, canadiantire.ca, canadacomputers.com, newegg.ca, visions.ca), or a lowvyn.com/product-detail URL from another tool's result

name: verify_deal
title: Verify a deal
